newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VNU buys French business info supplier.
newsitem.headline: VNU buys French business info supplier.

text.p: Dutch publisher NV Verenigd Bezit VNU said on Monday it had taken over French business information supplier AXIS Conseil S.A.
AXIS is based in Paris and will be amalgamated with Claritas France, a unit of VNU Business Information Europe, VNU said.

AXIS delivers marketing information services to the motor industry, financial institutions and the telecommunications sector and its expertise in statistical data analysis and micromarketing would be a valuable addition to Claritas France's consumer behavior database, VNU said.
No financial details of the deal were given.
